subject: ghoul count
fact: Four ghouls emerged from the dark in a shambling line.
source_quote: four of them

subject: ghoul count
fact: Three remaining ghouls were affected by Calmer's divine power.
source_quote: the other three

subject: Calmer's divine attempts on wraith
fact: Calmer made two attempts to use divine power against the wraith, both of which failed.
source_quote: Two attempts. Two failures.

subject: Calmer's resurrection count
fact: Calmer has been killed once and revived in the temple.
source_quote: I have been killed once already in this gods-forsaken temple, revived at considerable cost

subject: Zephyr's ambush response
fact: Zephyr killed one ghoul before it could attack.
source_quote: The nearest one hadn't reached me yet... The creature dropped where it stood

subject: ghoul count
fact: Sequoia killed the last ghoul before it escaped.
source_quote: Sequoia put an arrow in the back of the last one

subject: session date
fact: The session occurs during the descent into the second level corridors and subsequent events, with no explicit calendar date provided.

subject: goblins count
fact: Goblins are hauling bags of coin through a hidden door.
source_quote: I saw the goblins. They were moving through a hidden door... hauling bags that clinked with the unmistakable weight of coin.

subject: ghouls count
fact: Ghouls are dragging looted weapons through the same passage as the goblins.
source_quote: Behind them, ghouls. Ghouls. Dragging looted weapons, threading the same passage with the same purposeful efficiency.

subject: fire snakes count
fact: Fire snakes are engaged in combat with water gargoyles.
source_quote: Fire snakes and a wounded salamander, locked in combat with four water gargoyles

subject: water gargoyles count
fact: Four water gargoyles are engaged in combat with fire snakes and a salamander.
source_quote: Fire snakes and a wounded salamander, locked in combat with four water gargoyles

subject: salamander count
fact: One wounded salamander is engaged in combat with fire snakes and water gargoyles.
source_quote: Fire snakes and a wounded salamander, locked in combat with four water gargoyles

subject: bag weight
fact: Each bag carried by the goblins weighs approximately sixty pounds.
source_quote: one bag, maybe sixty pounds of someone else's gold

subject: prisoner count
fact: Five prisoners are chained in the chamber, one of whom is freed.
source_quote: They were huddled against the far wall, chained at the wrist... Four still chained.

subject: prisoner release sequence
fact: The first prisoner is freed before the other four remain chained.
source_quote: The chains hit the stone floor. That was when the others found their voices. Four still chained.

subject: Air Temple hidden passage
fact: A hidden passage inside the Air Temple leads to the Deep Temple.
source_quote: Here's the secret door to the Greater Temple. A hidden passage inside the Air Temple itself

subject: second level corridor air temperature
fact: The air on the second level is cooler than the level above.
source_quote: The second level hit different the moment we reached it. Cooler air.

subject: Hall of Trophies dimensions
fact: The Hall of Trophies has broad steps of dull black stone descending from the north wall into shadow.
source_quote: Broad steps of dull black stone descended from the north wall into shadow

subject: door movement sequence
fact: The door opened and closed again while the party was distracted by the elemental battle.
source_quote: This one opened on its own. Just: open, when it had been closed a moment before. Then closed again.

subject: trophies value
fact: The trophies on the walls include mummified heads, torn battle standards, battered shields, and a broken broadsword, but no monetary value is stated.
source_quote: The trophies on the walls said as much: mummified heads... Torn battle standards. Battered shields. A broken broadsword...

subject: escape sequence
fact: The party slips away south during the elemental battle using steam for cover.
source_quote: We moved between the billows, staying low, staying quiet, letting the heat swallow the sound of our passage.

subject: summoning sequence
fact: Hartsch summons the Obsidian Edge for a war council immediately after the prisoner's information is obtained.
source_quote: Hartsch wanted them. Hartsch wanted his Obsidian Edge assembled, upstairs, immediately. War council. The summons had the texture of *now*.
